issue.title: tui_perf.md rule 12: a synchronously cleared guard flag never catches queued OptionList highlight echoes
issue.description:
Rule 12 ("Guard programmatic widget updates") in tui_perf.md prescribes a guard flag that is
set around a programmatic `OptionList.highlighted = X` assignment and cleared synchronously in
`finally:`. For `OptionList` that guard never fires: Textual posts `OptionHighlighted` as a
queued message, so the handler runs after the `finally:` has already cleared the flag.
Phase sase-17x.13.5 (epic sase-17x.13, commit 61f88ccd6) proved this in pilot tests: the
Command Line popup's highlight echo reset `CompletionPopupState.index`, so 10 Tabs left the
index at 1. The phase replaced the flag with per-row pending-echo counts plus an
option-identity check (`CommandLinePopup._pending_echoes`, `_set_highlight`,
`user_highlight_index` in src/sase/ace/tui/command_line/popup.py). Textual's `clear_options`
clears the highlight without posting a message.

Proposed by phase sase-17x.13.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #3) and routed by the sase-17x.13 land
agent, which re-read rule 12 at master ea130c678 and found it unchanged.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Rewrite rule 12: a guard flag cleared in finally: does not work for OptionList, because OptionHighlighted is queued and handled after the flag is cleared. Recommend instead a check that survives the message queue: count pending programmatic echoes per row (decrement when the echo arrives) and drop messages whose Option is no longer in the current list, or compare against the last programmatic index or a generation counter. Cite CommandLinePopup (src/sase/ace/tui/command_line/popup.py) as the reference implementation, and drop the call_later wording unless a widget whose echo really is synchronous still needs it.
